pages.title: Sui UpgradeCap Risk Radar — Package Upgrade Risk
pages.description: Explore Sui package upgrade risks: UpgradeCap ownership, upgrade policies and governance controls in one dashboard.
paragraphs: Sui UpgradeCap Risk Radar helps you inspect how Sui packages can be upgraded and who controls the upgrade capability.
Explore the dashboard and scoring guide to understand ownership, upgrade policy and governance controls. Assessments are contextual signals, not a security audit or a guarantee of safety.
